parameters.query:
INSERT INTO market_signals (title, source_url, signal_type, source, project, subreddit, author, published_at, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title }}',
  '{{ $json.link }}',
  'student_sentiment',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  'coursepulse',
  '{{ $json.subreddit }}',
  '{{ $json.author }}',
  CASE WHEN '{{ $json.published_at }}' = '' THEN NOW() ELSE '{{ $json.published_at }}'::timestamptz END,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_url) DO NOTHING;
